messages:
kyle: Heads-up — found a weird billing/quota mismatch when using delegated service tokens. Delegated requests sometimes get billed to the wrong project after proxy fallthrough.

anya: repro steps?

kyle: small example: client exchanges org token -> gets delegated_sa_token with claims {org: orgA, project: projectB, sub: sa-123}.
The proxy sometimes routes by origin project header instead of claim, so quota attribution flips.

raj: :eyes: Are we seeing double-metering or just misattribution?

kyle: misattribution mostly, but telemetry shows a few doubled counts when fallback kicks in and both proxy and backend emit usage.

sophie: This will bite customers on Dedicated. We need clear UX in console showing 'effective billing entity' per request.

anya: Proposal: add a claim-cache at edge (ttl 10s) keyed by token_id -> canonical attribution. Benefits: fewer lookups, consistent routing. Risks: stale claim after token rotation.

kyle: Example cache key / read logic:
```
cache_key = "deleg_claim:" + sha256(token_id + org_id)
value = {owner_org: orgA, owner_project: projectB, ttl: 10}
```
Edge checks cache first, falls back to introspect if miss.

raj: Telemetry? if both edge and backend emit metrics we'll double count again.

anya: We'll add a single 'attribution_source' tag: edge|backend|fallback and dedupe in downstream aggregator by request_id when present.

sophie: Console needs two columns on request log: claimed_owner / observed_owner + link to token view.

kyle: Rollout plan: 1) opt-in canary for 10% traffic on staging -> verify no double-counting; 2) enable TTL 5s initially; 3) 100% after 72h.

auth-bot: deploy queued: auth-edge v2.14 -> canary for 10% traffic scheduled

raj: Can we also emit an alert for 'attribution_mismatch_rate > 0.5% over 5m' ?

anya: yes, will add to SLO rules and a dashboard tile.

sophie: OK assign owners: anya -> implement cache + metrics tag; raj -> alert + dashboard; kyle -> rollout runbook + QA checks; sophie -> console mockups.

kyle: I'll open PRs and a short runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
